gwt.given: An Order instance has Name = "PO-48213" (a mapped string property, column 'Name', declared earlier in Order than ShipAddress and so carrying the lower MetadataToken) and ShipAddress = an Address instance with City = "Springfield" (Address's only mapped property, column 'City'); the ShipAddress property on Order is marked MapToModel and carries no column-mapping attribute of its own; Name and ShipAddress are Order's only two mapped-or-MapToModel properties
gwt.when: ToTvpRecord<Order> builds the table-valued-record projection for this Order instance by calling IterateTvpProperties, which recurses into Address's properties when it reaches ShipAddress
gwt.then: the resulting SqlDataRecord has exactly two columns: Name at ordinal 0 holding "PO-48213", and City at ordinal 1 holding "Springfield", both written into the same row as Order's own properties; ShipAddress contributes no column of its own, and Address's properties do not produce a second row or a separate result
